messages:
maria: quick FYI: deploybot queued a terraform apply for infra-network module (v3.4.1 -> v3.5.0) in tonight's change window 02:00 UTC. Need provider pin decision and an explicit rollback playbook for routes. @tony @kai

tonY: What's in the diff? Any IAM or stateful route replacements?

kai: Mostly SG tweaks and a NAT count change (1->2). There's also a module refactor that adjusts private route CIDRs (10.20.5.0/24 -> 10.20.6.0/24). CI picked up aws provider 4.72; I'd prefer to avoid bumping provider during the window.

maria: Proposal: pin provider to 4.70 on the release branch, apply module change only, then run provider bump in separate canary next week. Thoughts?

sam: Sounds safe. I'll lead the apply. Ops: paste the staging plan snippet so we can check for destructive ops.

ops-oncall: staging plan snippet:
```
# terraform plan
~ aws_route.private (destination_cidr_block: 10.20.5.0/24 -> 10.20.6.0/24)
+ aws_nat_gateway.main (count: 1 -> 2)
~ aws_security_group.app (ingress: add tcp/443)
```
Note: route change should be non-destructive, but confirm there are no implicit associations that could drop traffic.

deploybot: deploybot: apply scheduled by @maria for 2026-03-28T02:00:00Z. Apply id: 87123. Abort: `deploybot cancel 87123` up to 15m before start. Command: `terraform apply --auto-approve --var-file=release.tfvars`.

tonY: Rollback checklist (draft): 1) revert module version to v3.4.1 on release branch 2) run `terraform apply --target=module.network --var-file=rollback.tfvars` 3) if routes flapping, follow runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/network-route-restore 4) if state inconsistent, consult state-restore runbook and contact SRE. I'll add this to release notes.

kai: I'll monitor route tables and BGP metrics during apply. @sam will run rollback commands if we see >5m packet loss.

sam: I'll be online from 01:40 UTC. If apply shows route diffs that are destructive, I'll pause via deploybot and run rollback. If partial apply occurs, we'll coordinate a manual state rollback.

maria: Pushed commit pinning provider to 4.70 and updated release notes under "infra: pin provider to avoid runtime drift". Branch: release/2026-03-28/net-pin. Deploybot id 87123. Please ack.

sam: acked. I'll post plan output when apply starts.

deploybot: deploybot: apply started (id:87123) at 2026-03-28T02:00:00Z  streaming plan output to this thread.

maria: thanks everyone. escalate to SRE pager if traffic drops.
